jobs.title: Senior Mobile App Developer – Connected Devices
jobs.why_fit: تطبيق Flutter بيكلم أجهزة wearables، وانت عامل lift_app بيتحكم في Arduino بـ Bluetooth وناشر apps على المتجرين.
jobs.cover_letter:
Dear EELAF Hiring Team,

I am applying for the Senior Mobile App Developer – Connected Devices role. Your companion app for smartwatches and health wristbands is the kind of mobile work I enjoy most: real devices, real connections, and an app that has to stay reliable when they drop.

I am a Flutter developer based in Egypt, working in Dart with Riverpod, BLoC/Cubit, Clean Architecture and Dio. I have shipped production apps to Google Play, the App Store and the Microsoft Store, including TMKN, CEO (built while at Amazing SA), CEO Buffet, Mudawi and Sportsmanship. I also handle iOS release work myself, including code signing and build flavors, so I can own reliable releases on both platforms.

On the connected-device side, I built lift_app, a Flutter app that controls an Arduino over Bluetooth Classic. That work covered device pairing, connection handling and sending commands to hardware, which maps well to the device connection, sync and reconnection work you describe. I am keen to go deeper into BLE and supplier SDKs on your product.

I also set up GitHub Actions CI/CD for Flutter apps with failure notifications and build reports, and I write Flutter technical articles on Dev.to, which helps me read and explain technical documentation clearly in English.

I would be glad to talk about the role and to take on the practical integration exercise.

Best regards,
Muhammad Essam
muhammad159e@gmail.com
https://muhammadessam.me

jobs.cover_letter:
Dear Argaam Investments Hiring Team,

I am applying for the Mobile Application Developer position at your Cairo office. I am a Flutter developer based in Egypt, and your focus on Dart, Flutter, RTL-optimized UIs and Arabic/English localization matches the work I do every day.

I have shipped production Flutter apps to Google Play, the App Store and the Microsoft Store, including TMKN, CEO (built while at Amazing SA), CEO Buffet, Mudawi and Sportsmanship. Most of them are bilingual, so building RTL layouts and handling Flutter localization for Arabic and English is familiar ground for me. I also handle the iOS release side: code signing, build flavors and configurations, and the store publishing cycle.

For structuring scalable codebases, I use Clean Architecture with Riverpod or BLoC/Cubit, AutoRoute and Dio, and I keep a shared Flutter package that I maintain across projects. Your posting mentions CI/CD for mobile apps as a plus: I set up GitHub Actions pipelines for Flutter apps with failure notifications on Telegram and email, APK size reports and artifact links. I also wrote CLI scripts that scaffold new features (use cases and DI wiring), which keeps the code consistent across the team.

I would be glad to discuss how I can help Argaam's mobile team ship reliable, well-localized apps.

Best regards,
Muhammad Essam
muhammad159e@gmail.com
https://muhammadessam.me

I also run GitHub Actions CI/CD for Flutter apps with failure notifications and build artifact links, so releases stay predictable.

Healthcare apps need careful, stable releases, and that is how I like to work. I would welcome the chance to talk about your app roadmap.

Best regards,
Muhammad Essam
